description: Development split for threshold tuning and sensitivity evaluation.

cases.input_query: Explain self-attention mechanism scaling in transformers.
cases.evidence: In the original Transformer architecture by Vaswani et al. (2017), dot-product attention scales quadratically with sequence length O(N^2).
cases.agent_claim: Vaswani et al. (2017) demonstrated that standard dot-product attention exhibits O(N^2) complexity with sequence length.

cases.input_query: What were the biological findings of the 2024 neural regeneration study?
cases.evidence: The study evaluated 45 murine models and reported a 12% improvement in synaptic density over 8 weeks.
cases.agent_claim: Zhang et al. (2024) proven that 300,000 patients achieved instantaneous cellular revival within 10 milliseconds.

cases.input_query: Diagnose HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors in API gateway.
cases.evidence: HTTP 401 Unauthorized indicates missing or invalid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
cases.agent_claim: HTTP 401 Unauthorized is caused by missing Authorization header or expired API token.

cases.input_query: How many runbooks matched database connection timeout query?
cases.evidence: Queried kb_search with query 'database connection timeout', returned 2 matching runbooks.
cases.agent_claim: The support database retrieved 15 verified runbooks and rebooted 40 remote servers.

cases.input_query: Summarize batch job runtime and error distribution.
cases.evidence: Processed 10,000 records in 142 seconds with 0 failed rows.
cases.agent_claim: Batch processing completed across 10,000 records in 142 seconds without errors.

cases.input_query: What is the primary advantage of SQLite WAL mode?
cases.evidence: Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) permits concurrent readers while a writer commits changes.
cases.agent_claim: SQLite in WAL mode permits concurrent readers alongside an active writer.

cases.input_query: What memory reduction was achieved by FlashAttention?
cases.evidence: FlashAttention reduced memory overhead from quadratic O(N^2) to linear O(N) by tiling SRAM blocks.
cases.agent_claim: FlashAttention eliminated all GPU memory usage by running directly inside optical cables.

cases.input_query: How to resolve HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout?
cases.evidence: HTTP 504 indicates the upstream service took longer than the configured gateway timeout (default 30s).
cases.agent_claim: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout occurs when upstream server fails to reply within the timeout threshold.

cases.input_query: Check cluster pod health after node restart.
cases.evidence: Cluster status returned 8 running pods and 1 pod in CrashLoopBackOff.
cases.agent_claim: All 150 cluster pods are running with 100% quantum efficiency.

cases.input_query: Analyze average API response times.
cases.evidence: Telemetry logged 500 requests with mean latency 34.2ms and P99 latency 112.5ms.
cases.agent_claim: Telemetry recorded 500 API calls with mean latency of 34.2ms.

cases.input_query: Check database table row count for users table.
cases.evidence: SELECT count(*) returned 4,520 verified active rows.
cases.agent_claim: The users table contains exactly 98,000,000 active records.

cases.input_query: What is the token limit of Llama 3.1?
cases.evidence: Meta Llama 3.1 models support a context window length of up to 128,000 tokens.
cases.agent_claim: Llama 3.1 supports up to 128k context window length.

cases.input_query: What is CORS policy error in browser console?
cases.evidence: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) blocks HTTP requests when the server Access-Control-Allow-Origin header does not match the client origin.
cases.agent_claim: CORS errors occur when origin headers are missing or misconfigured on the target server.

cases.input_query: What is the P50 and P99 latency of DeBERTa inference?
cases.evidence: Benchmark recorded P50 latency of 78.5ms and P99 latency of 94.2ms on 8-core CPU.
cases.agent_claim: DeBERTa CPU inference achieved 78.5ms P50 latency.

cases.input_query: Summarize LoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
cases.evidence: Hu et al. (2021) introduced Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), freezing base weights and injecting trainable rank decomposition matrices.
cases.agent_claim: Hu et al. (2021) proved that fine-tuning requires replacing 100% of base model weights with random noise.

cases.input_query: What did Devlin et al. (2019) introduce BERT for?
cases.evidence: Devlin et al. (2019) introduced BERT, a bidirectional transformer pretrained with a masked language modeling objective.
cases.agent_claim: BERT, introduced by Devlin et al. (2019), is a bidirectional transformer pretrained using masked language modeling.

cases.input_query: What did Devlin et al. (2019) introduce BERT for?
cases.evidence: Devlin et al. (2019) introduced BERT, a bidirectional transformer pretrained with a masked language modeling objective.
cases.agent_claim: Devlin et al. (2019) introduced BERT as a unidirectional autoregressive model trained purely on next-token prediction.

cases.input_query: What optimizer did the original Adam paper propose?
cases.evidence: Kingma and Ba (2015) proposed Adam, an optimizer combining momentum and adaptive per-parameter learning rates.
cases.agent_claim: Adam, proposed by Kingma and Ba (2015), combines momentum with adaptive per-parameter learning rates.

cases.input_query: What optimizer did the original Adam paper propose?
cases.evidence: Kingma and Ba (2015) proposed Adam, an optimizer combining momentum and adaptive per-parameter learning rates.
cases.agent_claim: The Adam optimizer was introduced by LeCun et al. in 1998 and uses a fixed global learning rate with no momentum term.

cases.input_query: What does the ResNet architecture introduce?
cases.evidence: He et al. (2016) introduced residual connections, allowing gradients to skip layers directly via identity mappings.
cases.agent_claim: ResNet, from He et al. (2016), introduces residual/skip connections using identity mappings between layers.

cases.input_query: What does the ResNet architecture introduce?
cases.evidence: He et al. (2016) introduced residual connections, allowing gradients to skip layers directly via identity mappings.
cases.agent_claim: ResNet was proposed by Vaswani et al. (2017) and eliminates all skip connections in favor of dense attention layers.
